description: Return the 13 Catholic Social Doctrine principles distilled from Magnifica Humanitas, organized by tier (Foundational / Classical CSD / AI-Distinctive). Each principle includes its key, Magnifica Humanitas paragraph references, and translations in all 15 supported languages (name, short description, operational system-prompt text, and a direct MH quote). Call this when the user asks 'what are the principles', 'what's in the compass', 'tell me about Catholic Social Doctrine', OR when the agent needs to explain WHY the compass says what it says (the principle keys + MH paragraph references support inline citations). The response's `_links` field points at /api/traceability if the user wants to dig deeper into encyclical source.
name: list_principles
